sources.snippet: Desert Ant Labs is a frontier AI lab for on-device models that run on Apple, Android and the web, in a few lines of native code.

sources.title: Desert Ant Labs - GitHub
sources.snippet: European AI lab building small, opinionated on-device models. Every model is free up to 100k monthly active devices per SDK. Unlimited inference per user. Drop-in SDKs for iOS, Android, Web, and Node, with open weights on Hugging Face.
